data.title: Costa Brava
data.about:
Costa Brava is the latest launch at Damac Lagoons by Damac Properties. This is the phase 2 launch of Lagoons featuring a stunning lifestyle. Choose from exquisitely crafted 3- 5 bedroom townhouses &  5-6 BR villas starting at AED 1.53 million.
Welcome to Damac Lagoons. Nestled opposite Damac Hills, Lagoons is not a home but a holiday destination. Home to 8 different Mediterranean city-themed clusters, each with unique amenities, here you are surrounded by water everywhere. Come home to Portofino, Andalucia, Malta, Nice, Costa Brava, Santorini, Morocco, and Venice. Sun-kissed white beaches, crystal lagoons, waterside cafes, and dedicated spots for sporting and adrenaline junkies. At Lagoons, you live each day like a vacation.

location_tile.title: Adjacent to the main DAMAC Lagoons hub and easily accessible from Hessa Street
location_tile.description:
This fantastic waterfront community is located between two major roads, Emirates Road (E611) and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311). Accessibility is immediate to the rest of the city, Damac Lagoons is located just opposite to Damac Hills.

  • 10 mins – Damac Hills | Dubai Autodrome
  • 12 mins – Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club | Dubai Sports City
  • 22 mins – Dubai Marina
  • 35 mins – Dubai International Airport
